propositions: Under reconciler.rich_text_cutover='cloud', the outbound comment differ computes its body-equality keys with different decoders: local side uses AdfCodec.normalize_outbound (markdown round trip with escaping), Jira side uses adf_to_text (no escaping), causing identical markdown comments to never match their landed form

The send path encodes the decorated body through markdown_to_adf which degrades to plain text when the decoration HTML comment is present, so the landed wire is literal markdown in plain paragraphs while the local key round-trips the undecorated body through rich encoding

A markdown comment well within the length limit diverges on the two sides of the dedup key: local key carries escaped markdown and rewritten autolinks, landed key carries the plain wire form, causing _diff_comments to re-emit already-landed bodies as duplicate mutations
The truncation notice marker itself exhibits the same asymmetry: local key carries [\truncated by reconciler\] (escaped), landed key carries [truncated by reconciler] (unescaped)

The fix derives the local dedup key by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same _normalize_comment_body decoder used on the Jira side, eliminating the asymmetry across all rich_text_cutover settings
